item.title: Please trim the hedge of Alexandra Rec Ground children's playground fronting onto the narrow Lennard Rd public footway in Penge., 1st August
item.description:
Please trim the hedge of Alexandra Rec Ground children's playground fronting onto the narrow Lennard Rd public footway in Penge. The growth is now over a foot (30cm) beyond the chain link boundary fence. Combined with inconsiderate parking (reported separately) the narrow footway is unacceptable narrowed and made hazardous with protruding branches and spikes. Please also raise the tree lower braches to say at least 2.5m above ground level for tall people and those using umbrellas. This is particularly an obstruction and hazard for blind and partially-sighted people, those with mobility scooters and walking aids, parents walking side by side with children etc. Reported under 'lawns' as there is no 'hedges' or 'overhanging vegetation' option. Please add one to FMS.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 33, Lennard Road, Penge, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Please amend this sixth direction sign in Green Lane near Penge Library to remove the car park 'P' and Shopping Centre description of the car park, 1st August
item.description:
Please amend this sixth direction sign in Green Lane near Penge Library to remove the car park 'P' and Shopping Centre description of the car park. Bromley Council sold the Blenheim Shopping Centre and multi storey car park about a decade or more ago. The new property speculators have emptied the Blenheim Centre shops and closed the multi storey car park about a year ago. The developers have permission to replace the centre and car park with blocks of flats with no public off street parking. Please remove this now redundant and misleading 'P' for parking symbol and car park name lettering.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 44-45, Green Lane, Penge, Greater London
